purpose: Geometric operations — watershed boundary manipulation, point-in-polygon, bbox, buffer

Polygon.area.note: Area is in the units of the CRS. For EPSG:4326 (degrees) this is meaningless — reproject first.
Polygon.area.example:
from pyproj import Transformer
# Reproject geometry before computing area

unary_union.note: shapely 2.0: use shapely.unary_union(geom_list) (module-level function), not geometry.union_all().

gotchas: shapely 1.x vs 2.x: from shapely.geometry import Point still works, but shapely.wkt.loads is removed — use shapely.from_wkt().
Area in EPSG:4326: polygon.area returns square degrees — always use an equal-area projection (EPSG:5070, EPSG:3857 is NOT equal-area).
Validity: complex polygons from NLDI may be invalid (.is_valid == False). Fix with shapely.make_valid(geom).
Coordinate order: shapely uses (x, y) = (lon, lat) everywhere. GeoJSON uses [lon, lat]. pyproj uses (lat, lon) in EPSG:4326 by default — pass always_xy=True.
Null geometry: GeometryCollection with 0 parts is falsy (bool(GeometryCollection()) is False) but is not None.
Bounds: geom.bounds returns (minx, miny, maxx, maxy). For rasterio, mask expects a dict via geom.__geo_interface__.
shapely 2.0 performance: vectorised functions (shapely.contains, shapely.intersects) are 10-100x faster than calling methods in a loop.
Precision: shapely.set_precision(geom, 1e-6) fixes floating-point topology errors before overlay operations.

common_patterns.bbox_to_polygon:
from shapely.geometry import box
bbox_poly = box(minx, miny, maxx, maxy)
common_patterns.make_valid:
import shapely
geom = shapely.make_valid(geom) if not geom.is_valid else geom
